questions.prompt: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the documents.
questions.explanation: After 'Not only' at the start of a sentence, the verb comes before the subject: Not only was he late.

wrongReasons.0: After 'Not only' the verb must come before the subject.
wrongReasons.2: 'did he' needs a main verb. With 'be', invert it directly: was he.

questions.prompt: She is said ___ the most talented pianist of her generation.
questions.explanation: Passive reporting structure: is said + to-infinitive.

wrongReasons.1: 'being' does not follow 'is said' in this structure.
wrongReasons.3: 'that she' would need a full clause: it is said that she is...
